result.topic_en: Draft notes on the differential equations for light propagation in the ether: the divergence-free condition, wave equations for the displacement components, curl/divergence notation, a modified wave equation with a pressure term, an energy-type integral required to be a minimum, and a discussion of conditions for transversal waves.
